house.name: No Name Perfume
house.desc: Indian clone house (nonameperfume.in) bottling 25-30% oil-concentration EDPs in 50ml and 20ml sizes, roughly Rs.849-Rs.1299. Publishes full note pyramids, main accords and a verbatim 'Inspired by' line per scent; brand names are leetspeak-obfuscated on-site (e.g. 'M@ison Margi*la') as a trademark precaution. Researched live 2026-10-02.
